current_evidence: The council's 'Scheme of Local Validation' page (last reviewed 7 Aug 2024) says the scheme has been updated for 2024. The July 2024 SoLV PDF states it was published July 2024 after consultation from 11 June to 1 July 2024 and lists earlier reviews in 2013, 2015 and 2017. No 2026 replacement was found by search.

issues.detail: Grokbot links the February 2017 Colchester Borough Council list, which has been superseded by the July 2024 Scheme of Local Validation. The 2024 document says local requirements only count for validation if the list was published less than 2 years before the application, so the 2017 list has no force.
issues.evidence: SoLV July 2024: 'Previous reviews: 2013, 2015 and 2017'; consultation 11 June - 1 July 2024

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Planning page' is the bare homepage (www.colchester.gov.uk) rather than the Scheme of Local Validation page (https://www.colchester.gov.uk/scheme-of-local-validation). The date basis is PDF metadata rather than text, although the 2017 document's own text does say February 2017.
issues.evidence: Validation_List_2017.pdf title: Planning Validation Requirements List (February 2017)

issues.detail: These requirements appear only in the 2024 list (or were missed) and are absent from Grokbot's rows: Biodiversity Net Gain package (BNG statement, metric, draft BNG plan, baseline, exemption statement; all developments), Tree Canopy Cover Assessment (all majors, 10% canopy increase), Climate Change Emergency Checklist (all majors), Housing Viability & Delivery Statement (all major housing), LVIA/Townscape Appraisal (all majors), SuDS water quantity and quality proforma (majors with SuDS), Part M4(3) accessibility information (residential), Draft s106 agreement or Unilateral Undertaking (major).
issues.evidence: SoLV July 2024 requirement table; Scheme of Local Validation page list of 14 document types

issues.detail: Also missing although present in both lists: Agricultural Appraisal (agricultural workers' dwellings or removal of occupancy condition), Agricultural Diversification Plan, Air Quality Impact Assessment (AQMA; 10+ homes or 500 sqm in the AQAP area), Amendments Statement (s73 / variations), Archaeological Assessment, Community Facilities Justification (loss of a community facility), Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings or >1,000 sqm non-residential), Heritage Statement (heritage assets, LBC, pre-1900 structures), Land Contamination Assessment, Lighting Assessment (non-householder with floodlighting), Parking and Access Arrangements, Renewable Energy Statement (ASHP, solar, biomass, CHP, battery storage), Retail/Leisure Impact Assessment (>2,500 sqm), Telecommunications information (telecoms prior approval and applications), Streetscenes (2+ dwellings on a street frontage, CA, or next to a listed building).

Householder is marked '(none)', but the list's general requirements apply to householder applications too: Design and Access Statement (in a designated area, 100 sqm+), Heritage Statement, Tree survey (all applications must show trees and answer Q15), Biodiversity/ecology, Parking and access changes, Site sections, Roof plans. Listed building consent is marked '(none)', but the DAS is required for 'all Listed Building Consent applications' and so is the Heritage Statement. Variation of condition s73 is marked '(none)', but it needs an Amendments Statement. Change of use - prior approval is marked '(none)', but telecoms prior approvals need telecommunications information.
issues.evidence: DAS: 'all Listed Building Consent applications'; Amendments statement: 'variations, or condition removal (s.73)'

issues.detail: Most rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Many are major-only in the source (SuDS, Viability, Transport Assessment, Land Contamination, LVIA, Canopy Cover), and Travel Plan is for non-residential schemes of 50+ employees. 'Roof plan' and 'Street scene elevations' are placed under Outline, although the source explicitly excludes outline applications from roof plans and the other detailed drawings.
issues.evidence: Roof plans: 'Where a roof is created or altered (excludes outline)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments or the wrong text. Affordable Housing Statement is 'in the Affordable Housing Statement.' (no threshold; the source says 10+ homes urban / 5+ rural / 0.5 ha+). The Biodiversity Checklist trigger is cut off ('unless the development is for'). Environmental Statement is 'would constitute EIA development.' Planning Obligations / S106 uses viability text run into ventilation text. Statement of Community Involvement uses the structural survey sentence (the source trigger is large-scale or controversial applications). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses tree survey text, and the list has no schedule of works requirement. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is the ECC SuDS checklist, duplicating Drainage Strategy / SuDS.
The tab_items are process or guidance text: paper copies must be submitted as 2 sets, and an advisory note to follow the 'Land Affected by Contamination' booklet.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'For applications submitted as a paper copy, 2 complete sets of all documents must be submitted.'

summary: Grokbot uses Colchester's superseded February 2017 list. The current list is the July 2024 Scheme of Local Validation, which adds BNG, canopy cover, the climate emergency checklist, LVIA and housing viability requirements. Even against the 2017 list, Grokbot missed over half the requirements, wrongly marked Householder/LBC/s73 as having none, and has garbled triggers.
